Oleg Shutov (born August 9, 1988) is a Ukrainian footballer.

Playing career 
Shutov began his career in 2006 in the Ukrainian First League with FC Stal Kamianske, where he featured in 217 matches and recorded 13 goals  In 2015, he played with NK Veres Rivne in the Ukrainian Second League, and helped the club achieve a promotion to the first league by finishing second in the standings.
